description: Launches a GPU server billed to the account. Requires the confirmationToken of gpucloud_quote_server for exactly these arguments and the key caps. Neither a card nor the automatic reload is required when the credits pay the first hour; the saved card is charged (and then needed) only for missing credits (at least $25, or the automatic reload amount when larger) or a monthly / annual order. Without enough funds (no credit and no usable card, or a cap reached) it returns a tool error with httpStatus 402 and accountAction (code PAYMENT_REQUIRED; BUDGET_CAP_REACHED for a cap) carrying the message and the console link to fix it; the quote itself never carries a payment link. Hourly: the answer carries onFundsExhausted and, when the automatic reload is off, autoReloadWarning. The owner receives an email for every spend. [SPENDS MONEY] (permission: servers:create) [Requires a free GPU Cloud account and MCP key]

confirmationToken.description: Token returned by the previous (quote) call, valid 10 minutes, single use.

cycle.description: hourly: first hour from credits, then billed per hour. monthly / annual: first month charged to the saved card.

onFundsExhausted.description: Hourly servers: what happens when the balance reaches the server threshold and no automatic reload brings it back. HIBERNATE (default): hibernated (its GPU place is kept, hourly hibernation fee), restarted as soon as the balance is back, deleted after 12 h without credit. DELETE: deleted at once, no hibernation fee, data lost. Machines that cannot be hibernated (spot) are always DELETE.

templateId.description: Optional one-click template installed at creation (gpucloud_list_templates): jupyter, ollama-openwebui, vllm, comfyui, pytorch.

templateModel.description: Model served by the vllm template (gpucloud_list_templates models[].id); default: the first one.

name: gpucloud_create_server
title: Launch a server (spends money)
